L3 mods may not change the sub’s settings, add or delete flair, add or delete other mods, or ban users.

1. An active user in that system sub must have positive SCP and CCP for that sub. Thresholds may be set if required.

2. Additionally, that active user must have overall positive SCP and CCP for the site as a whole.

3. Periodically (weekly? monthly?), the system sub selects active users (say the top 5) and offers those users the role of being an L3 mod.

5. L3 mods may now act on posts and comments which violate that subs rules. At the end of the prescribed duration, L3 mods are automatically reverted to regular users of that sub.

6. L3 mods should not be allowed to ban users from that sub.

7. L3 mods can not add or delete mods to the sub.
